fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: A text description of the desired output. Maximum length is 2500 characters. (Max length: 2500 characters)

fields.name: input_urls
fields.label: Input Urls
fields.description: An array containing a single image URL. The photo must clearly show the subject's head, shoulders, and torso. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/jpg; Max size: 10.0MB,size needs to be greater than 300px, aspect ratio 2:5 to 5:2.)

fields.name: video_urls
fields.label: Video Urls
fields.description: An array containing a single video URL. The duration must be between 3 to 30 seconds, and the video must clearly show the subject's head, shoulders, and torso. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: video/mp4, video/quicktime; Max size: 100.0MB)

fields.name: character_orientation
fields.label: Character Orientation
fields.description: Required. Generate the orientation of the characters in the video. 'image': same orientation as the person in the picture (max 10s video). 'video': consistent with the orientation of the characters in the video (max 30s video).

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Required. Output resolution: "720p" or "1080p".

fields.name: video_url
fields.label: Video Url
fields.description: URL of the input video. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/x-matroska; Max size: 10.0MB)

fields.name: image_url
fields.label: Image Url
fields.description: URL of the input image. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp; Max size: 10.0MB)

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated video (480p, 580p, or 720p).

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.label: Nsfw Checker
fields.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

fields.name: video_url
fields.label: Video Url
fields.description: URL of the input video. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/x-matroska; Max size: 10.0MB)

fields.name: image_url
fields.label: Image Url
fields.description: URL of the input image. (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp; Max size: 10.0MB)

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated video (480p, 580p, or 720p).

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.label: Nsfw Checker
fields.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Video description. It must not be empty after leading and trailing whitespace is removed. Maximum length: 3,072 characters.

fields.name: video_urls
fields.label: Video Urls
fields.description: Array of video URLs. Exactly 1 video is required. HTTP, HTTPS, and OSS URLs are supported. Videos must be in MP4 or MOV format; each file must not exceed 200 MB; duration must be between 3 and 15.5 seconds; width and height must each be between 700 and 4,553 px; total pixels must not exceed 8,294,400; the aspect ratio must be between 0.4 and 2; and the frame rate must be between 24 and 60 fps.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.label: Image Urls
fields.description: Array of image URLs. The maximum number of images depends on the number and types of reference subjects. When using only multi-image subjects, the combined number of reference images and multi-image subjects must not exceed 4. Video character subjects cannot be used together with multi-image subjects or reference images. HTTP, HTTPS, and OSS URLs are supported. Images must be in JPG, JPEG, or PNG format; each file must not exceed 50 MB; both width and height must be at least 300 px; and the aspect ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: duration
fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Video duration. This field may be configured when using a video with images.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Video resolution. `720p` outputs a 720p video, `1080p` outputs a 1080p video, and `4k` outputs a 4K video.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.label: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Video aspect ratio. Only `auto` can be used with video-only input. When using a video with images, `16:9`, `9:16`, and `1:1` are supported; `auto` is not supported.

fields.name: audio
fields.label: Audio
fields.description: No audio is generated when a video is provided; set false.

fields.name: elements
fields.label: Elements
fields.description: List of one-time subject assets. The default is an empty array.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Optional text prompt describing the expected elements and visual features in the generated video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 5000 characters.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.label: Negative Prompt
fields.description: Optional negative prompt describing content that should not appear in the video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 500 characters.

fields.name: video_url
fields.label: Video Url
fields.description: URL of the source video to edit. Required. Only one video is supported.

fields.name: reference_image
fields.label: Reference Image
fields.description: Optional reference image URL for character, clothing, or style guidance.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Output video resolution tier. `1080p` costs more than `720p`. Default value: `1080p`.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.label: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Output video aspect ratio.

fields.name: duration
fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Output video duration in seconds.

fields.name: audio_setting
fields.label: Audio Setting
fields.description: Video audio setting.

fields.name: prompt_extend
fields.label: Prompt Extend
fields.description: Whether to enable prompt rewriting. When enabled, the model expands the input prompt. This usually works better for short prompts but increases processing time.

fields.name: watermark
fields.label: Watermark
fields.description: Whether to add a watermark. The watermark is placed in the lower-right corner of the video with the fixed text "AI generated".

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.description: Random seed. Range: `0-2147483647`. If omitted, the system generates one automatically.

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.label: Nsfw Checker
fields.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Required edit instruction describing the intended change (e.g., style transfer / local replacement). Up to 5,000 characters.

fields.name: video_url
fields.label: Video Url
fields.description: URL of the input video (one video).

fields.name: reference_image
fields.label: Reference Image
fields.description: Optional reference image URL list (0–5).

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Output video resolution: 720p or 1080p (default).

fields.name: audio_setting
fields.label: Audio Setting
fields.description: Audio handling: auto lets the model handle audio; origin keeps the input video's original audio where possible.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.description: Random seed for reproducibility.
